<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Hide/Show form fields - Req New Cert</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
    //Hide/show catalog form fields based on request certificate purpose

    var ga = new GlideAjax("global.CSRGeneratorAjax");
    ga.addParam("sysparm_name", "isCSRGenerationEnabled");
    ga.setErrorCallback(
        function(error) {
            //doing nothing to fail silently.
        }
    );

    ga.getXML(function(response) {
        response = JSON.parse(response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer"));
        if (response == "true" || response == true)
            g_form.setDisplay('want_to_generate_csr', true);
    });

	var certUtil = new GlideAjax("sn_disco_certmgmt.CertificateManagementSystemUtil");
	certUtil.addParam("sysparm_name", "isAutoRenewalOptionsEnabled");
	certUtil.setErrorCallback(
        function(error) {
            //doing nothing to fail silently.
        }
    );
	certUtil.getXML(function(response) {
        response = JSON.parse(response.responseXML.documentElement.getAttribute("answer"));
        if (response == "true" || response == true)
            g_form.setDisplay('auto_renew_enabled', true);
    });


    var internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables = ['csr'];
	var internalCertPurposeVariables = [];
    var externalCertPurposeVariables = ['validity_period'];
	var fieldsTobeDisabled = ['organization', 'organizational_unit', 'locality', 'province', 'country', 'email', 'subject_common_name', 'subject_alternative_name'];

    var certificatePurpose = g_form.getValue('certificate_purpose');

    if (certificatePurpose) {
		setDisplayFields(internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(internalCertPurposeVariables, (certificatePurpose == 'internal'));
        setDisplayFields(externalCertPurposeVariables, (certificatePurpose == 'external'));
    } else {
		setDisplayFields(internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(internalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(externalCertPurposeVariables, true);
    }

	setDisabledFields(fieldsTobeDisabled, true);
	g_form.setDisplay('generate_csr', false);
	g_form.setDisplay('auto_renew_enabled', false);
	g_form.setDisplay('auto_renew_days_before_expiry', false);

    function setDisplayFields(formFields, display) {
        formFields.forEach(function(item) {
            if (item == 'csr' || item == 'validity_period') {
                g_form.setMandatory(item, display);
            }
			g_form.setDisplay(item, display);
        });
    }

	function setDisabledFields(formFields, disabled) {
		formFields.forEach(function(item) {
			g_form.setMandatory(item, !disabled);
			g_form.setDisabled(item, disabled);
		});
	}
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fc1255253bc37610be82c237f4e45a62</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Hide/Show form fields - Req New Cert</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_fc1255253bc37610be82c237f4e45a62</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
